<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Supply''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍補給物資</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：1フォース失って2フォース起動する。ロスト：1フォース失って4フォース起動する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Imperial-Supply-PSA-86099789.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国は恐怖を原動力として軍事物資を効率的に供給する。紛争が起こる地域に次々と武器や装備を移し替え、戦術的に重要な拠点に物資を最大限に集中させるのだ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Supply.

'''Card text:'''
USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.

'''Lore:'''
The Empire uses fear as a driving force to supply military goods efficiently. It shifts weapons and equipment to conflict regions and concentrates supplies on tactically important bases.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Used and Lost numbers match the English face.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Supply]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
